meta.notes: Columns merged from the archived iOS 11-17 repo and the iLEAPP Ph001/Ph002 artifacts (iOS 11-26). Where the same logical column has different expressions across versions the newest source wins. Placeholders {{AA_*}}/{{AL_*}} are resolved against the actual database at run time.
